## Which file do I need?

Cognitive Terrain runs in your web browser. Nothing to install.

| You want to… | Download |
|---|---|
| Play straight away on any computer | **cognitive-terrain-0.21.html**, then double-click it to open in your browser |
| Read the rules | **Cognitive-Terrain-Field-Manual-0.21.pdf** |
| Controls and rules on one sheet, two-sided, to keep by the keyboard | **Cognitive-Terrain-Quick-Reference-0.21.pdf** |
| Run it for a group, build campaigns, see why it works | **Cognitive-Terrain-Practitioners-Manual-0.21.pdf** |
| Hear each week read aloud (optional) | the **Immersive Briefings** voice pack, on its own release: **voice-emma-1** |

Two-player games work as long as both players use a 0.21 build (0.21.0, 0.21.1 and so on).

## What's new

- **Lessons Learned is worth buying.** It now gives every node of yours a
  bigger push when played, adds more recovery each week, and, new, lets nodes
  the other side has taken start to come back by themselves. Before, a node
  lost to a Bot Swarm never recovered on its own. The opponent's version gets
  the same boost, still at half strength.
- **The decision-loop outlines are on by default**, so you can see the five
  areas, and where an attack will land, from the first turn. Settings ›
  Display turns them off.
- **New players start on Recruit.**
- **The in-game Guide matches the PDF.** Numbered lists, bullet lists and the
  screen key on several pages lost their layout in the game.
